concept: A chip is a small object you press to include or remove something; its state changes shape and fill, never colour alone.

root.why: a pill with a ring, the same held shape as buttons at a smaller size

on.why: selected chips flip to the loud solid and show a check mark, so selection is visible without colour

toggle.why: the main press area is a native button with aria-pressed, so the state is announced

remove.why: removal is a separate named button, so removing is never an accident of toggling

removable.why: a removable chip shortens its toggle padding so the remove button sits inside the same pill

icon.why: the check and cross icons are a second cue next to the label and hidden from screen readers

focus-visible.why: keyboard focus draws the shared ring with its halo so the focused control is visible on any scene

active.why: a press shrinks the control briefly and faster than hover, because a press is a reply to the reader

@media forced-colors: active.why: forced colours drop glass and fills, so a real system-colour border is drawn to keep the shape visible

background-color.why: selecting eases the fill at hover pace so the change reads as the chip turning over

color.why: the label colour flips with the fill over the same duration so the two move as one

transform.why: the press shrinks at the shorter press duration because it is a direct reply
